ARDC > Resource Hub > Data Provenance. # Data Provenance. Australian Research Data Commons 2024, Data Provenance, viewed 20 March 2026, https://ardc.edu.au/resource/data-provenance/. https://ardc.edu.au/resource/data-provenance/. “Data Provenance.” 2024, https://ardc.edu.au/resource/data-provenance/. Available from: https://ardc.edu.au/resource/data-provenance/. https://ardc.edu.au/resource/data-provenance/. Available: https://ardc.edu.au/resource/data-provenance/. Data provenance is the documentation of where a piece of data comes from and the processes and methodology by which it was produced. Put simply, provenance answers the questions of why and how the data was produced, as well as where, when and by whom. Data provenance is metadata that confirms the authenticity of that data and enables it to be reused. ## Why data provenance matters. Data provenance provides essential information for determining data quality and facilitating reproducibility and reliability of data. Accurately recording data provenance is a cornerstone of good data management. ### For data users. Data provenance is the information that confirms the authenticity of a dataset so it can be confidently reused. ### For data producers. Providing provenance metadata as part of the published data helps others assess the quality and reusability of your data, the reproducibility of results and, ultimately, the amount of trust one can place on the results. ## How to record and manage data provenance. Provenance is recorded as metadata about the data product. Many metadata fields routinely collected fall into the category of provenance information such as date created, creator, instrument or software used and data processing methods. * recorded in a text string; using generic or discipline-specific schema; or a provenance data model. In its simplest form, provenance can be recorded in a single README text file that describes the data collection and processing methods. Alternatively, provenance information can be described directly in the W3C Provenance Data Model (PROV-DM) and Provenance Ontology (PROV-O). ## More data provenance information. * The ARDC has a playlist of data provenance videos. ### Toolkit for Clinical Research Data Sharing Frameworks. A practical toolkit to guide ethical and effective sharing of clinical research data in Australia.…. ### Secondary Use of Clinical Trials Data in Health Research: A Practical Guide. * Data Provenance Metadata: Builds Trust, Credibility and Reproducibility. Enabling the discovery and reuse of research data. Manage your research data efficiently.

results.title: Provenance Metadata Standards for Reliable Data
results.content: # Provenance Metadata Standards for Reliable Data. ## Data Science Provenance Metadata. Documenting data origins, modifications, and lineage with provenance metadata builds confidence and transparency. This article discusses provenance metadata in data science, its applications, standards, and tools. Data provenance metadata describes its origins, modifications, and processes. Data scientists need provenance metadata for numerous reasons:. Provenance metadata makes data history transparent, building trust. By documenting data’s path, changes, and procedures, provenance metadata allows data analysis to be reproduced. Data and model versioning helps capture provenance metadata. Versioning data and tracing its lineage helps capture provenance metadata. **E-commerce:** Tracking consumer and product data with provenance metadata improves trust and personalisation. **Complexity:** Tracking data transformations and procedures to capture provenance metadata is difficult and resource-intensive. Data science provenance metadata’s future consists in addressing difficulties and improving capabilities:. Trustworthy and repeatable data science relies on provenance metadata. As data ecosystems evolve, provenance metadata will become more important, requiring new tools, standards, and procedures to implement it.
